e22_esb_population: Four rows of the same 6,038-row roster, chosen before any contact by the SAME deterministic rule the 2026-09-04 ESB test smoke used -- longest, shortest, median, p90 by duration, ties broken by sample id: 4470684-13 the LONGEST at 78.360000 s (the window-fit and VRAM worst case, and the reason this population needs a bigger slot than the test one), 4469088-654 the SHORTEST at 0.219938 s, 4483937-267 the median at 5.519938 s and 4482383-119 the p90 at 12.860000 s. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.
e22_esb_identity_hash_convention: e22_esb_split_identity_hash is data.splits.split_identity_hash(prefixed('earnings22-original', sample_ids)) over earnings22-original/<call>-<segment>, the value core.flight.FlightRuntime.preflight computes at flight time and the value an exposure row must carry.
e22_esb_d1_media_supplement: The same additive media supplement the full dev10 fragment names; these four ids are four of its 6,038.
e22_esb_split_role_basis: No owner allowance is involved and none is claimed: these four utterances come from three calls of this study's registered earnings22-original dev subset10 (docs/receipts/splits.json, split 'dev'). No confirmatory call is named, loaded, decoded, scored or read.
e22_esb_reference_boundary: The 'sentence' column is gold and NEVER enters the request path. The roster receipt this fragment names carries identifiers, media paths, measured media identity and segment spans only.
e22_esb_exposure: Pre-flight smoke for SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-A-V1 and SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-B-V1: same model fragment, same roster, same scorers, both instructions; only the dataset fragment differs from the flight cells. This fragment grants no contact authority; the preregistration and the exposure ledger do.
